text:
elaine: Heads-up — we have 4 open SDK-snippet PRs in the docs queue and only one reviewer on rotation today. Can folks self-assign or swap shifts? :eyes:

mike: which PRs? can you drop links? I can take one after lunch.

elaine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487
https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/495
https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499

jaidev: I can grab 487 (migration snippets) and 495 (rust SDK example). 492 looks like a content-only fix (link + minor wording) — maybe the junior docs reviewer can do that.

olivia: I was scheduled for reviewer coverage but got pulled into a support spike. Can swap with sam? @sam any chance you can cover the merge window 4–5pm?

sam: yeah I can cover 4–5pm. I'll pick up 499 and 492.

mike: cool. quick note — CI preview for 495 is flaky right now, docs-bot posted the preview but images sometimes 404. If you see missing assets, re-run with `./scripts/docs-preview --force` or re-trigger the GH action.

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-495--docs.redwood.ai (status: waiting for images).

elaine: thanks. two small process asks: 1) if you take a docs PR, add a short comment like "reviewing — ETA 1h" so rotations visual. 2) for migration guides, please check the snippet outputs by running the example locally (`make examples && ./examples/run.sh`) — we've had regressions due to param name changes.

jaidev: noted. will comment.

olivia: sam — once you merge 499 can you tag the PR with `docs-merged` label so we can auto-pick for release notes?

sam: yep will add `docs-merged`. also planning to squash-merge unless objections. :shipit:

mike: a quick reminder: merge window policy — non-security docs fixes can be merged during quiet windows (10:00–16:00 local) but not during release cutover (16:00–17:00). since sam is 4–5pm, double-check there's no active cutover.

elaine: confirmed no cutover today. thanks all. I'll update the rotation calendar to mark the swap. :handshake:

jaidev: one follow-up: can we create a tiny checklist in PR template for SDK snippets (run examples, check output, ensure code block language tags). saves a lot of back-and-forth.

elaine: yes — I'll open a tiny PR to add checklist items to .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and ping docs-reviewers list.

olivia: awesome, ty.

sam: taking 499 now. leaving a comment on each PR with ETA.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs-preview action may need `CI_IMAGE_CACHE=true` for deterministic image builds.

mike: noted. if preview still 404s after re-run, ping #eng-infra.

elaine: perfect. closing loop — coverage swapped, reviewers assigned: 487 -> jaidev, 495 -> jaidev, 492 -> sam, 499 -> sam. ETA for merges: between 16:05 and 16:45. cheers! :tada:
